candidates.rule: current and immediately previous windows are anomalous
at least two anomalous states among the latest three windows
at least three anomalous states among the latest five windows

selection_order: among candidates passing the validation alert reduction gate, maximize unweighted macro-average trajectory detection across long_stop, repeated_backtracking, circular_wandering, abnormal_speed_pattern
if tied, minimize pooled median delay from event-evidence availability to first product ATTENTION
if still tied, choose the simplest rule: B before C before D

event_evidence_availability.long_stop: behavior onset plus 300 seconds of observed event time

validation_normal_metrics.window_level_fpr: raw V2 anomalous windows divided by quality-valid validation windows; identical for all policies
validation_normal_metrics.trajectory_level_alert_rate: validation trajectories with at least one product ATTENTION decision divided by validation trajectories
validation_normal_metrics.alerts_per_trajectory: product ATTENTION rising edges divided by validation trajectories

temporal_semantics.unknown_prior_window: breaks consecutive evidence; counts as non-anomalous in voting rules
temporal_semantics.episode_count: a new alert episode starts on each non-ATTENTION/UNKNOWN to ATTENTION transition
